items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I think he had Zuddy over there doing something; he had Zuddy before me. Then they got over to me, and I was over there after Zuddy.

ctx.x: to go to Europe, and he put Mezzrow in his place for a while. I don't know what happened. But anyway, I was with Mezzrow for a while. Something happened down at Jimmy Ryan's, and that's when they decided to get ...(? )...(? )... somebody's name(?) anyway...

But Mezz went to Europe, and stayed over there a long time. He had been there before, I think. He learned to speak the language. And during that time, that's when he wrote that book, Really The Blues -- I think it was that time. But he decided he wanted to... He got a lot of dates lined up, and he had... I think he had Zuddy over there doing something; he had Zuddy before me. Then they got over to me, and I was over there after Zuddy. They had a big run-in or something, he and Zuddy, they had a fight or…
For the recording(?) date... He played two or three more days to kind of warm up before going into the Olympia Theatre, because that's a big place...
